summary: Pit-subsystem lookup on the frame path: reads the owner vehicle pointer stored at this+0 and its team ID at +18596 (offset 0x48A4), then scans the global vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 for a different vehicle carrying the same team ID. Returns that teammate's part value at +13392 (offset 0x3450), or 0 when the vehicle count dword_5C329C is empty or no teammate matches. Called by ForcePitExit (0x0042A110) to read teammate pit status.

operations.description: Read v1 = *this, dereferencing the pit machine's stored owner vehicle pointer (field at this+0).
Read v2 = team ID of the owner vehicle at *(v1 + 18596) (offset 0x48A4).
If dword_5C329C (vehicle count) is <= 0, return 0 immediately without scanning.
Scan the global vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 from index 0 while index < dword_5C329C.
For each vehicle v4, break when its team ID at +18596 (0x48A4) equals the owner's v2 AND v4 is a different vehicle than the owner (pointer inequality v4 != v1).
Return 0 when the scan exhausts the vehicle count without finding a teammate.
Return the teammate's part value at *(v4 + 13392) (offset 0x3450).

unresolved: Semantics of the part value at +13392 (offset 0x3450) are not confirmed by the packet; existing analysis reads it as teammate pit status consumed by ForcePitExit.
Ordering/index semantics of the global vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 are external to this function.
